features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
The Ancient Dragons add spells to your warlock spell list:

| Spell Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | inflict wounds, magic missile |
| 2nd | heat metal, scorching ray |
| 3rd | dispel magic, lightning bolt |
| 4th | greater invisibility, ice storm |
| 5th | cloudkill, flame strike |

features.name: Dragon Tongue
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you can speak, read, and write Draconic.

features.name: Wyrmling Blessing
features.description:
Also starting at 1st level, when you finish a long rest, choose one blessing (lasts until next rest):

**Aquatic Affinity.** Swim speed = walk speed; breathe underwater; speak with water-breathing beasts.
**Draconic Hunger.** When below half HP and you reduce a hostile to 0 HP: regain HP equal to 2× prof bonus (up to half your HP max).
**Draconic Sight.** Darkvision 60 ft (+30 if existing). As an action, create an invisible sensor within 30 ft for 1 min (see/hear through it; blind/deaf to own senses). Move sensor 30 ft as bonus action.
**Elemental Versatility.** Choose one damage type (acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison); your spells can deal that type instead of their normal type.

features.name: Draconic Mien
features.description:
At 6th level, choose one damage type (acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison) on a long rest: gain resistance to it for the duration.

As an action, manifest a spectral dragon visage. Choose up to 3 creatures within 30 ft: WIS save vs your spell save DC or be charmed or frightened (your choice) until end of your next turn. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Draconic Mien
payload.description: Manifest spectral dragon visage: up to 3 creatures within 30 ft make WIS save or be charmed or frightened until end of your next turn.

features.name: Ascended Blessing
features.description:
At 10th level, when you finish a long rest, choose one ascended blessing (includes its wyrmling blessing):

**Aquatic Command.** Wyrmling Aquatic Affinity + cast *control water* and *dominate beast* (water-breathing beasts only) once each per long rest without a spell slot.
**Crystallized Hunger.** Wyrmling Draconic Hunger + on kill, create an essence gem (*ioun stone of protection*, you only). As bonus action, destroy it to regain one spell slot. One gem at a time. 1/long rest.
**Draconic Senses.** Wyrmling Draconic Sight + blindsight 15 ft and advantage on Perception.
**Elemental Expertise.** Wyrmling Elemental Versatility + add CHA mod to one damage roll of spells dealing chosen type. Reaction: when hit within 5 ft, deal prof bonus in chosen type to attacker (prof bonus uses per long rest).

features.name: Draconic Manifestation
features.description: At 14th level, as an action, transform into a dragon with CR up to your warlock level ÷ 3 (round down) for 1 minute. Like *polymorph* but no concentration required. Retain INT, WIS, and CHA. Can target any dragon-type creature. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Draconic Manifestation
payload.description: Transform into a dragon (CR ≤ warlock level ÷ 3) for 1 min (no concentration). Retain INT/WIS/CHA.
